"""Camera-guided controller for the single service episode. No resets or scene-state access."""
import json, pickle, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
ROOT=Path('/app/output'); RUNS=Path('/app/runs')

def load():return pickle.load(open(ROOT/'obs.pkl','rb'))
def save(o,label):
 o.save(str(RUNS/label))
 pickle.dump(o,open(ROOT/'obs.pkl','wb'))
 out=Image.new('RGB',(640,480))
 for i,(k,a) in enumerate(o.last.items()):
  im=Image.fromarray(a);ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((4,4),k,fill='red');out.paste(im,((i%2)*320,(i//2)*240))
 out.save(ROOT/'views.png')
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);print('state',label,'q',p[4:11], 'eef',p[26:29], 'fingers',p[11:13],'time',o.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)

def state(o):return np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
def point(o,cam,u,v):
 c=o.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']);d=o.depth[cam];d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
 z=float(d[v,u]);p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z]);return T[:3,:3]@p+T[:3,3]

def moveq(q,label,seconds=2,grip=None):
 o=load();p=state(o);q0=p[4:11];n=int(seconds/.05);A=np.zeros((n,13));t=np.linspace(0,1,n);t=t*t*(3-2*t);A[:,:7]=q0+(q-q0)*t[:,None];A[:,7]=p[36] if grip is None else grip;A[:,12]=-1
 np.save(ROOT/(label+'_actions.npy'),A)
 o=Robot().submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none',note=label);save(o,label);return o

origins=[(0,0,.333),(0,0,0),(0,-.316,0),(.0825,0,0),(-.0825,.384,0),(0,0,0),(.088,0,0)]
rx=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for qi,p,a in zip(q,origins,rx):
  B=np.eye(4);B[:3,3]=p;B[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('x',a).as_matrix()@Rotation.from_euler('z',qi).as_matrix();T=T@B
 return T

if __name__=='__main__':
 o=load()
 for cam,u,v in [('robot0_agentview_center',124,170),('robot0_eye_in_hand',124,115),('robot0_agentview_left',59,170)]:
  print(cam,u,v,point(o,cam,u,v))
 print('fk',fk(state(o)[4:11]))
PY

def model(q):
 k=np.load(ROOT/'kinematics.npz');T=fk(q);return k['root']+k['B']@(T[:3,3]+T[:3,:3]@k['tip']),k['B']@T[:3,:3]@k['Rcam']
def ik(x,R,q):
 def err(qi):
  p,Ri=model(qi);return np.r_[ (p-x)*4,Rotation.from_matrix(R@Ri.T).as_rotvec(),(qi-q)*.002]
 lo=np.array([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.07,-2.89,-.017,-2.89]);hi=np.array([2.89,1.76,2.89,-.069,2.89,3.75,2.89])
 sol=least_squares(err,np.clip(q,lo+1e-5,hi-1e-5),bounds=(lo,hi),xtol=1e-10,ftol=1e-10,gtol=1e-10,max_nfev=100)
 if np.linalg.norm(model(sol.x)[0]-x)>.005:raise ValueError(('IK',x,model(sol.x)[0]))
 return sol.x

def movex(x,label,seconds=3,R=None,grip=None):
 o=load();p=state(o);q=p[4:11];x0,R0=model(q);R=R0 if R is None else np.array(R);rv=Rotation.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec();n=int(seconds/.05);A=np.zeros((n,13))
 for i,t in enumerate(np.linspace(0,1,n)):
  t=t*t*(3-2*t);q=ik(x0+(np.array(x)-x0)*t,Rotation.from_rotvec(rv*t).as_matrix()@R0,q);A[i,:7]=q
 A[:,7]=p[36] if grip is None else grip;A[:,12]=-1;np.save(ROOT/(label+'_actions.npy'),A)
 o=Robot().submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none',note=label);save(o,label);return o
